candidateDispositions.note: 天 is personified Heaven in 天未厭亂, the historian’s explanation of continuing turmoil.
Jin identifies the dynasty meant as the recipient of Yizhong’s recommended submission, 歸順.
How renders the rhetorical comparison 何以加焉, after the titles of the two ancient rulers.
Instead renders the adverb 翻 contrasting this conduct with the preceding appraisal.
桑門 designates Buddhist monks as a group. Buddhist qualifies that group.
Buddhist describes the stupa built at Yonggui. The adjective identifies no human individual.
非天喪也 rejects destruction by Heaven as an explanation for the dynasty’s fall.
長安 is the city taken by the advancing army.
Qin identifies the historical ruler’s polity in the comparison. The candidate covers the word Qin alone.
